change: When applying a QCad-1 layer pen, normalize an inherited ByLayer or ByBlock width to the default layer width. Preserve explicitly concrete values if the importer acquires them in future.
validation: The focused QCad-1 linetype/layer control passes 18 assertions with the system codec and 16 with the bundled codec, including physical default lineweight and save/reopen.
The system control also sets an invalid inherited layer width, checks refusal and destination preservation, restores the valid value, and retries through the same filter.
The system [filter][linetype] selector passes 49/52 cases and 1243/1281 assertions; three cases remain failing.
limits: This fixes the QCad-1 import path; it does not globally normalize invalid layer lineweights.
Native GUI, final candidate and broader linetype qualification remain open. No generated drawing was committed.
